title: Signal: Permissive WebView capability enabled via settings.setAllowFileAccess(true) (file) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the WebView setting in file source.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches the grant; whether the WebView ever loads untrusted content is reviewed separately.
fpNotes: A WebView that only shows bundled offline help pages is the narrow accepted case.
